batch: OLP-0191–0197 Models of Arithmetic under the cumulative Model Theory profile
method: Fresh comparison of every exact frozen-English and Gujarati linguistic block, with independently worded reverse paraphrases for every substantive block. The review covers standard and non-standard arithmetic models, Q and PA model structure, computability, Tennenbaum's theorem and all sixteen adjacent disclosed source repairs. Three rejected candidates were separately recorded and preserved.
